correctness.rationale: For F_k=K_1∨kK_2 each leaf has two differently colored neighbors in every proper coloring; only the hub requires a singleton color among leaves. Two leaf colors cannot yield a singleton for k≥2, while the explicit 3-color matching assignment does. Recoloring repeated leaves realizes every total palette size 4 through 2k+1. For a specified singleton color, 2k choices of vertex times 2^k choices of remaining matching edges; disjoint singleton events for k≥3 yield 24k·2^k with four choices of center color, while k=2 inclusion-exclusion subtracts 3·8 overlaps giving 96. k=1 gives K3 and 6. Exact independent enumeration k=1..4 confirms 6,96,576,1536. The all-k proof is combinatorial, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Friendship/windmill graphs are a canonical infinite family with a common hub; the singleton-witness obstruction produces an exact structural theorem, full feasible-color spectrum and a nontrivial closed labeled minimum-color enumeration. These are natural PCF invariants beyond an arbitrary tiny case or a broad four-color upper bound.
